cds.title: Western Kentucky University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025): applicants, admits and enrolled are given by gender only (added together); no residency or international split is published, so no international admit rate is shown. The Common Data Set lists 74 nonresident undergraduates (all undergraduates, including non-degree) and 13 nonresident first-time students. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled' column. No early decision or early action; no waitlist; rolling notification. SAT/ACT percentiles cover only the 246 SAT and 1,844 ACT submitters.

cds_test_policy.notes: Common Data Set (fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'. An unweighted HS GPA of 2.50+ needs no test; a GPA of 2.00-2.49 means the student must submit a test and reach a Composite Admission Index of 60.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set: WKU marked its 2026-27 costs as not yet available and printed final 2025-26 figures (tuition per year; required fees not readable in the Common Data Set). International (nonresident) tuition $27,648 vs out-of-state $27,000. Institutional need-based and non-need-based aid both exist for nonresidents; 45 nonresident undergraduates received it (average $27,705)
